Strike leans 2 strikes down with the morning's move from the open (-2.23%), which is reversing the gap: the put is in the money, so a continued move pays on that leg more than the other leg loses; a sharp turn the other way still pays through the other leg. Some news points the other way (1).

Exits (unchanged): take profit at 50% above the cost, stop at 35% below it, out by 15:15.

thesis.strategy: Buy the at-the-money call and put.
why: Used when a big move is plausible but its direction is not: either leg can pay for both. It loses if the index drifts, because time decay eats the premium.
